Name: Rain Refills Watering Can
Author: StultusVMods
Description:
This mod simply makes it so rain slowly refills your watering can's water over time while you're outside.
It has two configuration options:
[list=1]
[*]You can customize how much water is refilled during each interval. An interval is simply 10 in-game minutes. The default value is 1, and can be changed to any non-negative integer. Keep in mind, this will NOT let you fill your watering can over the max capacity. See [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Watering_Cans#Grades_of_Watering_Can]this page[/url] on watering can capacities to﻿
[*]You can choose whether or not you need to have your watering can equipped in-hand for it to refill. If set to "true", then it will only refill the watering can if you have it equipped as your active tool. If set to "false", it will refill the can as long as it's in your inventory.﻿
[/list]
[size=5]Install[/size]
[list=1]
[*][url=https://smapi.io]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].
[*]Download this mod and unzip it into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font].
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]

[size=5]How to use[/size]
Once the mod is successfully installed, it will simply start refilling your watering can whenever you're outside in the rain!

[size=5]Compatibility[/size]
[list]
[*]Works with Stardew Valley 1.5.6 on Linux/macOS/Windows.
[*]Works in singleplayer, and lightly tested in multiplayer, but it should still work. Let me know if it does anything weird.
[/list]
